mapper.insert: INSERT INTO menus ( store_id, menu_name, menu_price, menu_cost, packaging_fee, expected_cooking_time, batch_capacity, menu_status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{storeId}, #{menuName}, #{menuPrice}, #{menuCost}, #{packagingFee}, #{expectedCookingTime}, #{batchCapacity}, #{menuStatus}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM menus WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update:
UPDATE menus
menu_name = #{menuName}, menu_price = #{menuPrice}, menu_cost = #{menuCost}, packaging_fee = #{packagingFee}, expected_cooking_time = #{expectedCookingTime}, batch_capacity = #{batchCapacity}, updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = #{id} AND store_id = #{storeId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM menu_loss_dismissals WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND hide_until > NOW()
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO menu_loss_dismissals ( store_id, menu_id, dismissed_at, hide_until, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{storeId}, #{menuId}, NOW(), #{hideUntil}, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE hide_until = VALUES(hide_until), dismissed_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW()
